messages:
amelia: Kicking off soft ramp for v1.12 now. US->EU->APAC, 5% slices, 10m holdpoints. Observability: https://dash.internal/redwood/releases/3180007777 :rocket:

deploy-bot: [info] scheduled rollout v1.12 slices: US(5%) EU(5%) APAC(2%). change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. exec id: dpl-3180007777

raj: Can infra confirm GPU warm pool counts? Need cushion for US spike.

ops-lead: US warm pool: 140 GPUs (20% headroom). EU: 48 GPUs (5% headroom). APAC: 36 GPUs (0% headroom).

sophia: EU looks tight — latency p95 trending +18% on canary last 10m. Suggest hold EU slice until we probe quant config.

amelia: @sophia can you paste the p95 trace?

sophia: p95 spikes on seq_len>1024. trace: /traces/seq/3180007777; query: 'customer_summary' shows KV cache misses.

deploy-bot: canary US slice succeeded, no errors. EU slice paused by ops-lead.

raj: Recommend pin EU traffic to v1.11 for now and continue US ramp. We'll backfill EU with extra warm pool if needed.

ops-lead: Pinning EU routes to v1.11 in traffic-router now. command: routingctl set-pin --region eu --version v1.11 --until 2026-03-21T08:00Z

amelia: Noted. APAC: we were planning 2% but APAC queue latency is fine. There's maintenance in ap-southeast-1 at 03:30 UTC — ops-scheduler flagged it. Move APAC ramp after maintenance +30m.

sophia: Set APAC holdpoint.

deploy-bot: Applied holdpoint: APAC. Execution paused. To resume: /deploy resume dpl-3180007777 --region apac

raj: Updating release notes: add known EU latency regression, pinned EU to v1.11, APAC delayed. I'll draft a short blurb.

amelia: :thumbsup: Also, can QA run the regression suite on EU canary image (v1.12) with synthetic long sequences? @qa-bot

qa-bot: scheduled regression run 3180007777-eu-longseq, ETA 18m. Results will post to #eng-releases.

sophia: If QA confirms it's KV-cache related, ops wants a hotfix config: set kv_cache_size=1.2x for EU nodes and retry.

ops-lead: Rollback plan if hotfix fails: 1) Pin to v1.11 (done). 2) Deploy config hotfix to canary EU. 3) If still bad -> full rollback and incident page.

amelia: Timeline: US ramp to 15% over next 30m. EU pinned and under investigation. APAC delayed until maintenance clear. I'll post summary to #release-notes once QA completes.

deploy-bot: US slice ramped to 15% (dpl-3180007777). metrics: tokens/sec +8%, errors 0.2%. Continue monitor for 20m.

raj: Adding runbook note: threshold for auto-rollback is error_rate >1% OR p95 increase >25% sustained 5m. Documented: https://runbooks/internal/rollout-guardrails

qa-bot: eu-longseq run complete. Failures: 13/120 tests, root cause: KV misses under seq>1024. Log: /logs/3180007777/qa-eu.log

ops-lead: Given QA fail, proceed with hotfix config patch, canary EU to deploy with kv_cache_size=1.2x. Scheduling now.

deploy-bot: initiating config deploy dpl-3180007777-config-eu-hotfix. Canary EU at 3%.

sophia: After hotfix canary p95 back to baseline. 10m observation looks good.

ops-lead: Remove EU pin? Keep canary v1.12, but keep route pin until stable. Recommend increasing EU warm pool by +16 GPUs to reach 20% headroom.

raj: Ops to request extra capacity from cloud: ticket #CHG-8472 created.

amelia: Agree. I'll note in release notes: EU pinned, hotfix applied to canary, APAC delayed for maintenance. Hold one more observation then unpin. Thanks team.
